item.title: Claude Agent integration opens 3 blank VS Code windows when Anthropic extension starts a session
item.body:
## Summary

When opening a Claude Code session from the Anthropic VS Code extension (`claude-code`), GitHub Copilot Chat spawns **3 blank "Welcome" VS Code windows**. This happens on every session start and is reproducible 100% of the time.

## Environment

- **VS Code**: 1.98.x (Windows 10 Pro)
- **Copilot Chat extension**: v0.38.2
- **Anthropic Claude Code extension**: latest
- **OS**: Windows 10 Pro 10.0.19045

## Root Cause Analysis

Copilot Chat v0.38.2 registers **3 separate chat providers** for the `claude-code` session type:
1. `createChatParticipant`
2. `registerChatSessionContentProvider`
3. `createChatSessionItemController`

When the Anthropic extension creates a `claude-code` session, VS Code broadcasts `onChatSession:claude-code`. Each of the 3 provider registrations triggers a new window context, resulting in 3 blank "Welcome" windows.

### Extension Host Logs

The extension host logs show `onChatSession:claude-code` activation events firing 3 times — once per provider registration — each spawning a separate window.

## Workaround

Setting `"github.copilot.chat.claudeAgent.enabled": false` in VS Code settings mitigates the issue but disables Copilot's Claude Agent feature entirely.

Removing `"github.copilot.chat.cli.sessionController.enabled": true` alone does **not** resolve the issue.

## Suggested Fix

- Guard session provider registrations to **reuse existing window context** instead of creating new ones
- Don't register for the `claude-code` session type when the session originates from the Anthropic extension (not from Copilot's own Claude Agent feature)
- Alternatively, deduplicate `onChatSession` activation so multiple provider registrations within the same extension don't each spawn a new window

## Reproduction Steps

1. Install both GitHub Copilot Chat and the Anthropic Claude Code VS Code extension
2. Ensure `github.copilot.chat.claudeAgent.enabled` is `true` (default)
3. Open a Claude Code session from the Anthropic extension (panel or terminal)
4. Observe 3 blank "Welcome" VS Code windows spawning
